title: Investigate Skipped Searches and Scheduler Capacity
objectives: Investigate Skipped Searches and Scheduler Capacity
Demonstrate actual outcomes and independently inspect evidence.

tasks.instruction: Five actual managed reports share a minute boundary; the fixture retains a real skipped dispatch under the bounded four-dispatch-per-head-per-minute capacity. Inspect the report execution receipts and Monitoring Console evidence.

Stagger Capacity report 1 through 5 to UTC crons 5 * * * *, 6 * * * *, 7 * * * *, 8 * * * * and 9 * * * * respectively. Preserve their recorded-data query. Activate the changes and advance through those five minute slots (up to the next hour if needed). Verify each revised report produces count=3, and compare the new receipts with the earlier skip. Do not equate this teaching capacity with production CPU sizing.

hints: Inspect running source and actual receipts before changing configuration.
Use the paused fixture clock deliberately; verify results through a separate view or query.
